Name: Wire ModelRouter tier table into agent provider construction in bins/hone
Description: hone-providers/src/router.rs ships ProviderTier + RoutePolicy + TierFallbackProvider (PR #2). The agent's provider is currently constructed without consulting the router. Add: (1) [providers.routing] config block that lists tiers, (2) construct TierFallbackProvider when policy != Auto, (3) wire into build_agent_config in bins/hone/src/main.rs. Acceptance: setting policy = "cheapest" in config routes simple turns to the cheapest provider tier with automatic fallback on 5xx/429.

Name: Register apply_patch tool in default tool registry
Description: PatchTool is implemented (PR #2) but not registered in build_tool_registry (bins/hone/src/main.rs ~line 700). One-line addition; gated behind a feature flag or env so it doesn't overlap with edit_file/multi_edit until validated.

Name: Wire PermissionPolicy into shell tool dispatch + agent.rs
Description: hone-config/src/permissions.rs (PR #3) holds the data; agent.rs needs to call policy.decide(command) before each shell call. Allow=auto-approve, Deny=skip+inject error, Ask=fall through to existing approval flow. Persist user's "always allow" choices via PermissionPolicy::approve_always + save_to. Composes with PR #7's TUI approval menu.

Name: Add TUI prompt UI for permission requests
Description: After PR #7 made the approval menu surface for risky tool calls, the menu shows generic [proceed/skip/deny/always-approve] choices. Extend to show the specific shell command + matched rule (when PermissionPolicy::decide returns Ask) so users can make an informed choice.

Name: Wire TUI clipboard image paste
Description: --image FILE CLI flag works (PR #3); arboard is already a workspace dep. Add a TUI keybinding (e.g. Ctrl+V handles image data) that builds Content::Parts via the existing image_input::build_content helper and submits via AgentHandle::run_turn_content.

Name: Multimodal support in interactive (multi-turn) sessions
Description: Image input flows only through the one-shot CLI path today. Subsequent turns in interactive mode revert to text-only. Extend the TUI input handler so once an image is attached, the next turn sends Content::Parts.

Name: Wire HandoffTool into orchestrator drain-and-route logic
Description: hone-tools/src/handoff.rs (PR #4) records HandoffRequests into a shared HandoffBuffer; the orchestrator does not yet drain it. At end of each worker turn, orchestrator should call buffer.drain(), and for each request: validate target_agent exists, schedule a follow-up subtask with depends_on=[current_task_id]. Update task_plan.rs DAG dynamically.

Name: Register HandoffTool in default tool registry
Description: After the orchestrator integration above, register HandoffTool in build_tool_registry with the buffer wired to the active orchestrator session. Include valid_targets list from AgentRegistry to give the model self-correction.

Name: honed tick loop for ScheduleStore (P1-4)
Description: ScheduleStore is library-complete (PR #4). Add a tokio::interval task in bins/honed/src/main.rs that ticks every 30s, calls store.due_entries(now()), spawns each due entry as an agent run, calls mark_running -> record_completion. Reuse existing checkpoint/resume infra so long runs survive daemon restarts.

Name: hone schedule add/list/remove CLI subcommands
Description: After honed tick loop ships, add `hone schedule add --cron "0 9 * * *" --recipe daily-security-audit --name nightly`, `hone schedule list`, `hone schedule remove <name>`. CLI POSTs to a new /scheduler/* endpoint on honed. Mirrors `hone mcp` and `hone reports` subcommand patterns.

Name: OpenAI / Voyage / Ollama Embedder adapters
Description: hone-memory/src/embedding.rs ships the Embedder trait + MockEmbedder (PR #5). Add three real backends: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (HTTP), Voyage AI (HTTP), Ollama (local HTTP via existing OllamaProvider pattern). Each is ~80 LoC of HTTP + JSON.

Name: Embed-on-record + hybrid (BM25 + cosine RRF) recall in agent.rs
Description: After embedder adapters land: in Agent::record_memory, call embedder.embed(memory.content) and persist the vector. In Agent::run_turn's fetch_relevant_memories, do BOTH BM25 recall AND embedder.embed(user_input) -> recall_semantic, then rrf_fuse the two ranked id lists.

Name: sqlite-vec native vector index for hone-memory
Description: Today recall_semantic in SqliteStore reads all rows with embedding IS NOT NULL and computes cosine in Rust. Acceptable up to ~10K rows. Above that, integrate the sqlite-vec extension for native vector search. Override SqliteStore::recall_semantic to use vec_distance_cosine.

Name: MCP server: HTTP/SSE transport
Description: hone-mcp-server (PR #6) is stdio-only. Add a parallel transport that runs the JSON-RPC over HTTP+SSE so editors that prefer network sockets (vs spawning a child) can connect. Mirror the existing honed routes pattern.

Name: MCP server: implement resources/list + resources/read
Description: Today MCP server only implements tools/list and tools/call. Add resources support so the model can read project files via standard MCP semantics rather than via the read_file tool wrapper. Sources resources from working_dir + .hone/skills/ + agent definitions.

Name: MCP server: implement prompts/list + prompts/get
Description: Add prompts support so users can expose .hone/commands/*.md (the user-extensible slash commands from PR #1) as MCP prompts that other agents can invoke. Bridges the slash-command and MCP universes.

Name: MCP server: RBAC token model for inbound auth
Description: Today hone-mcp-server is unauthenticated (assumed local stdio). For HTTP/SSE transport (above), require Authorization: Bearer <HONE_MCP_TOKEN>. Per-token capability scoping (which tools each token can call) is a stretch.

Name: Surface MCP server as `hone mcp-server` subcommand
Description: Today the binary is bins/hone-mcp-server-bin which produces a separate binary. Add a thin `hone mcp-server` subcommand to bins/hone that delegates so users have one entry point. Mirrors the eval / spec / schedule pattern.

Name: MCP server: expose full bins/hone tool registry
Description: Today the bin spawns a default tool registry with only the read-only set (read_file/glob/grep/git_status/git_diff). Refactor build_tool_registry from bins/hone/src/main.rs into a shared library function so the MCP server can expose the full registry (LSP, MCP clients, memory tools, etc.) — factor without breaking the existing bins/hone construction.

Name: Persist TUI always-allowed permissions across sessions
Description: PR #7 fixed the approval menu surfacing. Pressing 'a' (always allow) updates the in-memory ToolApprovalPolicy::AskRisky always_allowed list, but it's lost on restart. Wire to PR #3's PermissionPolicy::approve_always + save_to(~/.config/hone/permissions.toml).

Name: Wire AgentDef.sandbox into bins/hone @agent dispatch
Description: AgentDef now carries optional SandboxProfile (PR #8). At @agent-name dispatch time in bins/hone (already wired for tool allowlist filtering), if def.sandbox.is_some() also build a per-agent SandboxPolicy via SandboxProfile::to_policy and apply to the worker.

Name: Ed25519 signing of provenance chain head
Description: hone-provenance (PR #8) gives tamper-evident hash chains. Add Ed25519 signing of the chain head per session for non-repudiation: store a sign() trailer on the last ProvenanceEntry; verify() checks the chain integrity AND the head signature. Add a new dep (ed25519-dalek).

Name: Wizard UI for MCP marketplace in `hone configure`
Description: hone-mcp/src/marketplace.rs (PR #8) ships the Marketplace registry library. Extend the `hone configure` wizard to: list builtin entries, let user pick one with arrow keys, copy command/args into their McpConfig, save. Surfaces install_hint when present.

Name: hone spec CLI subcommand
Description: hone-spec (PR #9) ships the library. Add `hone spec "build user auth"` that loads the user's wizard config, builds DefaultSpecGenerator with their provider, runs generate(goal), and persists via SpecStore::save. Print the path of the new spec dir.

Name: hone --spec <slug> execution wiring
Description: After `hone spec` ships: `hone --spec <slug>` reads tasks.md, decomposes to a TaskPlan (each Task -> SubTask with the agent name from frontmatter or default), runs through the orchestrator with execute=true mode, marks task status in place as each completes via SpecStore::save. Uses checkpoint.rs for resumability.

Name: TUI review UI between spec generate and execute
Description: Today `hone spec` would produce three .md files and exit. Add an interactive flow: after generate, open all three in $EDITOR (or a TUI panel), then prompt "approve and execute? [y/N]". Composes with the plan_mode UI from PR #1.

Name: Spec re-generation flow (regen one section without losing others)
Description: After review, the user may want to regen ONLY tasks.md without touching requirements.md / design.md. Add `hone spec regenerate <slug> --section tasks`. Backs up the existing version, regenerates with the existing requirements + design as context.

Name: ACP server bin wiring serve_stdio to real AcpHandler
Description: hone-acp-server (PR #10) ships the protocol layer. The bin currently uses MockHandler. Build a real AcpHandler that wraps hone_core::Agent::run_turn and translates ToolCallStart/End events into UpdatePayload::ToolCall / ToolCallUpdate notifications.

Name: ACP server: VS Code / Neovim / JetBrains plugin shims
Description: Zed already speaks ACP natively — once the bin wiring lands, Zed users can configure Hone as an external agent with one line of config. For VS Code / Neovim / JetBrains, write thin extensions that auto-spawn hone-acp-server and translate the editor's UI events to ACP messages. Each plugin is its own multi-week effort.

Name: ACP server: session/cancel + session/load
Description: Today the ACP server supports initialize + session/new + session/prompt. Add session/cancel (mid-prompt interruption — needs to plumb a cancel channel through Agent::run_turn) and session/load (resume an existing session id from disk).

Name: Move ACP wire types into hone-proto::acp
Description: PR #10 duplicated the wire types from hone-providers/src/acp/types.rs into hone-acp-server/src/types.rs. Move the canonical types to hone-proto::acp; update both the client and server crates to re-export. Mechanical 5-file change.

Name: honed cron wiring for eval-driven self-improve
Description: PR #11 ships EvalRunStore + RegressionBisector. Wire into honed: cron entry runs `hone eval` against a versioned task suite, persists via EvalRunStore::record(commit_sha, model, config_hash, "nightly"), then compares to latest_with_tag("nightly") and emits a regression report on detection. Reuses ScheduleStore from PR #4.

Name: Auto git commit-sha capture for eval runs
Description: EvalRunRecord.commit_sha is currently caller-supplied. Add a small helper in hone-eval that runs `git rev-parse HEAD` in the working dir at run start and populates commit_sha automatically. Falls back to None when not in a git repo.

Name: Compute config_hash across prompt + skeleton + tool registry
Description: EvalRunRecord.config_hash is currently caller-supplied opaque string. Add hone-eval::config_hash(agent_config) helper that SHA-256s the concatenation of system_prompt + skeleton output + sorted tool names. Lets the bisector attribute regressions to specific config changes.

Name: LoRA training pipeline integration
Description: hone-finetune (PR #12) ships the dataset builder. Pick ONE training path: (a) Python axolotl/unsloth wrapper invoked via subprocess from a `hone finetune train` subcommand; (b) candle-rs LoRA in pure Rust. Path (a) is faster to ship; (b) is more portable.

Name: Load .hone/reports/ session files into TrainingExample
Description: hone-finetune is generic. Add a hone_finetune::from_session_reports(dir) -> Vec<TrainingExample> helper that reads the existing .hone/reports/*.json session files and extracts (user_prompt, assistant_response, score) tuples. Score derived from heuristics: tools_succeeded / total_tools, presence of test passes, etc.

Name: Reward modelling / RLHF preference pair extraction
Description: For RLHF training the dataset shape is { chosen, rejected } pairs (not single (prompt, response)). Extend TrainingExample with PreferencePair variant; add ensemble session reports (which already produce N candidate responses) as the source of preference pairs ranked by the existing ranker.

Name: P2-4 Phase 1: DistributedTaskStore + HTTP endpoints + lease reaper
Description: First ~3 weeks of work for the distributed orchestrator. Per docs/research/p2-4-distributed-orchestrator-2026-05.md (PR #13). Acceptance: 1 coordinator + 1 worker on the same machine, 3-task plan, all results back via SSE. ~25 unit tests for DistributedTaskStore + 12 for HTTP endpoints.

Name: P2-4 Phase 2: Orchestrator integration (QueueClient + --distributed flag)
Description: Wire bins/hone to the new queue. Adds QueueClient to hone-core, --distributed flag to bins/hone, [distributed] config block to hone-config. Replaces in-proc dispatch path with queue-based path when flag is set. ~6 unit tests.

Name: P2-4 Phase 3: Worker side (poll loop + capability declaration + per-worker sandbox)
Description: Add the worker poll loop in honed: tokio::interval that polls /distributed/workers/<id>/claim, executes the SubTask via existing Agent infra, posts results. Capability declaration in honed config. Compose per-agent sandbox profile (from P2-5) with worker-machine sandbox profile.

Name: P2-4 Phase 4: Production hardening (SSE + cancel + provenance correlation + load test)
Description: SSE event stream + reconnect for the orchestrator->coordinator channel. Cancel endpoint to flip remaining queued/leased tasks to failed when user aborts. Cross-machine provenance correlation: a Merkle tree across workers. Load test script (10 workers / 5 machines) under benchmarks/.

Name: P2-8 Multimodal pipeline: write architecture proposal
Description: P2-8 is the only remaining roadmap item with neither code nor design. Write docs/research/p2-8-multimodal-pipeline-2026-05.md covering: (1) audio path via whisper.cpp FFI vs subprocess vs HTTP whisper API, (2) video frame sampling cadence + ffmpeg dep tradeoff, (3) screenshot OCR vs vision-model passthrough, (4) implementation phases like the P2-4 doc.

Name: P2-8 Multimodal: audio transcription via whisper
Description: After the design doc lands: pick the recommended whisper integration path and ship a hone-multimodal crate with AudioTranscriber trait + at least one impl. Wire `--audio FILE` CLI flag (mirrors --image from PR #3).

Name: P2-8 Multimodal: video frame sampling
Description: After audio: ship VideoFrameSampler (likely ffmpeg subprocess) that extracts N keyframes per minute and submits them as a multi-image Content::Parts. `--video FILE [--frames N]` CLI flag.
